The plate looks like a side plate of roughly 22 cm. On it are scrambled egg whites, or something similar, seasoned with pepper, plus a chia pudding with a few pieces of peach and blueberry.

The egg portion is about 80 g at roughly 1.4 kcal/g, which is around 110 kcal. The chia pudding portion is about 90 g at roughly 1.2 kcal/g, around 110 kcal. The fruit adds about 10 g and 5 kcal.

That gives roughly 180 g of food and about 225 kcal in total.
